description: Idempotent post creation: the client makes a new idempotency key on every submit, so a retry after a lost response still creates a duplicate post.
notes: FM-03 (irreversible side effects). The server side is sound (a unique nullable idempotencyKey column with onConflictDoNothing), but the client calls crypto.randomUUID() inside onSubmit, so every submit, including the retry after a timed-out request whose insert actually landed, carries a fresh key and the server inserts a duplicate post: the idempotency key is regenerated on retry, the exact case the ticket targets. The disabled button only covers the double-click. Severity important: FM-03 is critical only when a duplicate moves money or goods. Fix: create the key once per draft (useRef or form state), reuse it on retry, and rotate it only after a success. Schema, router and button changes are legitimate.
